name: Curaçao
summary: A Dutch commercial hub with two British interludes.
notes: An autonomous country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands since 2010. A country within the Kingdom is not an independent sovereign state.

events.title: Spain claims the island
events.detail: Alonso de Ojeda’s voyage reached the Caquetío islands.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: Spanish colonial administration
events.detail: Juan de Ampués’s administration followed slaving raids and forced removals.
events.uncertainty: A gradual process; this marks administration rather than first European arrival.

events.title: The Dutch West India Company takes Curaçao
events.detail: A Dutch expedition displaced the small Spanish administration.

events.title: Spain recognizes Dutch possession
events.detail: The Peace of Münster recognized the Dutch colonial holding.

events.title: British protection becomes occupation
events.detail: A French assault prompted the Dutch authorities to accept British control.

events.title: Dutch government restored
events.detail: The Treaty of Amiens ended the first British occupation.

events.title: Britain seizes the island
events.detail: A British naval attack began a second occupation.

events.title: The Dutch return
events.detail: Post-Napoleonic restitution was implemented after the 1814 agreement.

events.title: The Kingdom Charter
events.detail: The Netherlands Antilles obtained internal autonomy within the Kingdom.

events.title: Autonomous country in the Kingdom
events.detail: Curaçao became a constituent country as the Netherlands Antilles dissolved.
